description: Open-source, non-custodial, privacy preserving Bitcoin wallet for Windows, Linux, and Mac.
readme_summary: An open-source, non-custodial, privacy-focused Bitcoin wallet for desktop. 1. Get Git: https://git-scm.com/downloads 2. Get .NET 10.0 SDK: https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download 3. Optionally disable .NET's telemetry by executing in the terminal `export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1` on Linux and macOS or `setx DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT 1` on Windows. Run Wasabi with `dotnet run` from the `WalletWasabi.Fluent.Desktop` folder.
